title: fix(ui): keep stopped history intact during refresh
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the opening prompt and earlier rows disappearing when a refresh supersedes history recovery after stopping a long turn.

## User Impact

The chat keeps the transcript it already showed while reconciling the stopped turn. Routes, rendering, and the one-page recovery limit remain unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

The first recovery cleared its rejected cursor before its full-tail request finished. A superseding refresh therefore skipped reset recovery and could adopt a bounded tail after the active leaf changed. Retain the cursor until an accepted authoritative snapshot replaces it, so the existing recovery owner fills the held prefix.

If a fallback fails or is cancelled, a later retry may repeat one cheap rejected-cursor/reset exchange. Existing session, connection, and generation checks still own publication. Explicit window resets still clear their cursor.

## Evidence

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| New regression on base `b3e31b797c0b` | Fails at full-transcript assertion: opening prompt and first call missing |
| `chat-history.test.ts`, single worker | 26 passed |
| `chat-history-cursor.test.ts`, single worker | 16 passed |
| `pnpm tsgo:ui` | Passed |
| Scoped type-aware lint and format | Passed |
| Independent review, P0–P2 | Complete, no actionable findings |
| `pnpm deadcode:knip` | Passed |
| `pnpm ui:build`; `OPENCLAW_BUILD_PRIVATE_QA=1 pnpm build sourcePerformance` | Passed; matching commit and build timestamp |
| `pnpm test:ui:e2e ui/src/e2e/chat-stop-long-turn.real-gateway.e2e.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` | Passed, 1/1; no transient earlier-history boundary |

The final test-only adjustment removed an unnecessary default type argument; the runtime test inputs are unchanged. The new deterministic test asserts the complete transcript, one bounded gap read, and completed pagination. The existing real-Gateway test checks that no earlier-history boundary appears at any point after Stop; a final screenshot cannot establish that transient invariant, so this nonvisual fix uses assertion evidence.

Production LOC: **513 → 513**. Touched test LOC: **1,208 → 1,243**. Solid checklist counts for effects, render effects, untrack, listeners, DOM queries, flush, and manual owners: **0 → 0**. No new state, dependency, reactive owner, or abstraction.

Built and exercised commit `77c368ab9ac8feb60456e4594b09bfb0a0a87a2c` with matching UI/Gateway timestamp `2026-10-31T09:15:55Z`. Strict UI asset checks passed: startup JS **89,076 B gzip / 3 requests**, CSS **33,568 B / 1 request**. Headless Chromium, synthetic model provider, real isolated Gateway and exec tools. Host load was recorded (32 logical CPUs; load averages 17.28/20.40/22.36 at E2E start); no timing-win claim. `ci:full` supplies broad UI and real-Gateway proof.

Source reconciliation against current main `8ec6c76b5c13` found no changes in the eleven directly coupled history owners/tests since the base.
